They were coached, for the seventh year, by Kevin Willard.  They were members of the Big East Conference. 2011–12 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team | The 2011–12 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team represented Seton Hall University during the 2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season. The event will return to the early June slot of WWE's pay-per-view calendar and will be a Raw-exclusive pay-per-view event.
